defect: Terminal Stage0 workflows also listened to pull_request events. Opening archival PR #483 re-triggered both terminal candidates once after their authoritative terminal runs.
remediation: Clean archival branch rebuilt from main without either executable Stage0 workflow.
Duplicate runs are excluded from scientific evidence and do not alter terminal receipts.
future_rule: Terminal candidate workflows must not be merged as active pull_request/push triggers; preserve runner and contract for audit but archive execution wiring.
